name: World of ClaudeCraft v0.37.0 版本更新
summary: # World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.37.0 Release Notes
body:
版本 v0.37.0 发布，包含游戏底层架构迭代与前期核心系统打磨。

# World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.37.0 Release Notes
**Release:** v0.37.0
**Date:** 2026-08-13
**Previous release:** v0.36.0
Version 0.37.0 is a client performance and platform delivery release. The loading and
hitch-elimination campaign that started in v0.36.0 closes out its worst remaining
offenders, the native mobile shells gain real differential over-the-air updates behind a
visible update gate, the Android build finally fits under the Play Store size cap, and
the texture pipeline moves terrain to standalone KTX2. Around the platform work, players
get a bag item lock, a smarter World Market, backward Tab targeting, and authored bodies
